remarks: Experience unparalleled elegance and comfort. Designed by two renowned architects, this home has been seamlessly expanded and meticulously transformed into a chic and elegant home. The spacious living room with fireplace and French doors opens to a covered porch and magnificent sunsets. The sun-filled dining room with large bay window is perfect for wonderful meals and holiday feasts. The Family Room features vaulted ceiling, fireplace, three walls of windows, and new service center with marble counter, wet sink, and refrigerator. It opens to a stunning new kitchen and breakfast room. Luxurious finishes - shiplap ceiling, top-of-the-line appliances, 10-foot center island, 2-inch countertops. Ideal for entertaining and working, the home features a game room, a four-season solarium with a fireplace, and a dedicated office. The luxurious primary suite includes a fireplace, a large walk-in closet, and a beautiful light-filled bath. Four additional stylish bedrooms, each with new baths and walk-in closets, provide ample space for family and guests. Set on 2 acres of lush gardens and sweeping lawns, the outdoor spaces include a saltwater pool with a dedicated pool bath, terraces, and a covered porch. Located on a quiet cul-de-sac perfect for walking, running, and biking, the home is just 3 minutes from the historic and picturesque village center of New Canaan.
